verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for a payments API platform like Adyen, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of a versioning scheme, version lifecycle, or deprecation/sunset policy. The only hint is an incidental '/v1/ingestions' path in the Product Feed API. The OpenAPI repo is described as the 'single source of truth' but says nothing about versions or deprecation, so neither is enough to credit this story.
